**Summary of the Latest Approved AI Tools Policy Update**

The latest AI tools policy update introduces key changes and guidelines:

1. **Documentation and Transparency**: All AI-related communications must be documented via email to **records@external-archive.com** and published on the website [1].

2. **Scope**: The policy applies to all staff, consultants, and interns using generative AI tools for work, including text, image, code, audio generation, and AI assistants capable of system interactions [2].

3. **Intake Requirement**: An intake form must be submitted before developing or purchasing AI solutions exceeding personal productivity with approved tools. This includes assistants using team documents, automated workflows, or agents with system actions [3].

4. **Cost and Compliance**: A **free monthly allowance** for approved AI tools per unit is introduced. Usage exceeding this allowance or requiring dedicated infrastructure must be funded by the responsible unit. Cost estimates are reviewed after three months of operation [4].

**Note**: No explicit restrictions on specific AI tools, detailed data privacy guidelines, ethical AI use requirements, or third-party vendor compliance obligations were identified in the available notes.
